messages.author: 722aa7e225dda705
messages.subject: Worker() 函数出错问题
parts:
Hi all，

想咨询个问题，在设置分词引擎的时候，都会让Rstudio崩溃，这是为什么呢？麻烦各位解答下，很是困扰，多谢多谢。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> testDocument<-worker()
Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "jieba.dict.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath,  : 
  cannot open file 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.2/library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8': Permission denied
Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "hmm_model.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath,  : 
  cannot open file 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.2/library/jiebaRD/dict/hmm_model.utf8': Permission denied
Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "idf.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath,  : 
  cannot open file 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.2/library/jiebaRD/dict/idf.utf8': Permission denied
2016-11-09 00:55:47 ../inst/include/lib/DictTrie.hpp:140 FATAL exp: [ifs.is_open()] false. open C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.2/library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8 failed.
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'Rcpp::exception'
  what():  2016-11-09 00:55:47 ../inst/include/lib/DictTrie.hpp:140 FATAL exp: [ifs.is_open()] false. open C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.2/library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8 failed.

This application has requested the Runtime to terminate it in an unusual way.
Please contact the application's support team for more information.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
弹窗提示“Rstudio R Session has stopped working"，提示Problem Event name是APPCrash。这里我用的是最新版的R-3.3.2


望各位解答下，多谢！

Regards,
Yikai

messages.author: 3055471c1db79df6
messages.subject: Re: Worker() 函数出错问题
parts:
您好，这个提示是因为词典包所在的目录 'C:/Program Files/R‘ 可能需要管理员权限才能够读取，如果您不是管理员，权限会被拒绝，建议修改 R 包的安装目录，比如先卸载当前版本，然后用当前用户重新安装，应该就会安装到用户目录，而不是管理员目录，普通用户 R 包安装，会安装到我的文档等用户可以访问的位置。

或者可以使用管理员权限启动 R，就可以读取这些词典包了，但是一般不推荐这么做。
